thread:
evan.re: Heads-up: FinRegCo wants to run a 30-day POC but insists on strict EU-only handling for inference, logs, and key material. They're asking for the subprocessors list, a routing policy example we can commit to, and whether we can guarantee no cross-border telemetry during the trial.
marie.legal: We can provide subprocessors by legal entity + country. Need to confirm whether the scope includes ephemeral caches and telemetry exports. Also, will they sign a BYOK addendum or want us to host keys in EU KMS?
jon-infra: For hosted POC we can create a tenant pinned to either eu-west-1 or eu-central-1. Policy options: pin with regional-only failover (to another EU region) or pin with no failover (strict). For 30-day POC prefer pin + no failover to be safe.
evans.re: They may ask for zero cross-border telemetry. Is that enforceable?
ana-privacy: (typo: ana-privacy) We can disable analytics export and block telemetry pipelines for that tenant. Internal platform monitoring will still surface metrics to our EU telemetry cluster; nothing routes to US by default.
marie.legal: Note: If they require BYOK, we need the BYOK addendum signed and a short lead time to onboard their keys. We also need to confirm whether they want keys stored in their KMS (BYOK) or just customer-controlled keys hosted in our EU KMS.
jon-infra: Operational details: BYOK flow for hosted: customer uploads key material via tenant portal -> we validate -> activation ~48-72h. Subprocessors short list for EU-only POC: "Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL (Luxembourg)", "Google Cloud Europe Limited (Ireland)", "Cloudflare Europe Limited (UK/Ireland)", and our telemetry subproc "Redwood Telemetry EU (Redwood SAS, France)". Will produce full mapping file.
finregco-sec: Their SQ also asks: if we ever shift traffic due to a region outage, will any logs or key material move? They want written confirmation it will not for the POC.
jon-infra: Commitment we can make for the POC: - Tenant pinned to eu-west-1 (or eu-central-1) - Failover set to "none" (no automatic cross-region routing) - Backups and snapshots disabled or restricted to in-region only - Telemetry export disabled; audit logs retained in EU cluster only - BYOK: keys remain in customer-controlled EU KMS or our EU KMS with access restrictions.
evans.re: Can you paste the example JSON routing snippet we send in SOW?
jon-infra: Sure here's the minimal example we include in SOW: ```json
{"routing_policy":"pin","preferred_regions":["eu-west-1"],"failover":"none","backups":"in-region-only","telemetry_export":false}
```
nana-privacy: I'll validate the log retention SLA language. For POC, propose 30 days of audit log retention in-region and confirmation that no analytics export will run.
marie.legal: I'll draft the subprocessors appendix (legal names + countries) and the BYOK addendum. Will also add a clause: any breach of residency during the POC triggers an immediate remediation and credit; SLA penalty language deferred to enterprise contract.
deply-bot: (typo: deploy-bot) queued: enable-tenant-pin eu-west-1 for tenant finregco-poc -> ETA 2024-06-07T09:00:00Z :white_check_mark:
evan.re: Thanks — final asks before the call: 1) Full subprocessors list by EOD, 2) BYOK onboarding steps doc, 3) SOW snippet showing included 100GB cross-region egress allowance for the POC (beyond that pass-through).
jon-infra: Confirmed on 1 & 2; will attach full mapping. On egress: presales policy is to absorb up to 100GB cross-region egress for POCs; we'll document as part of SOW.
marie.legal: Confirmed on 1 & 2 from legal; I'll circulate the addendum and the subprocessors appendix after review.
nana-privacy: I'll sign off on the POC tenant config once infra posts the config.
finregco-sec: Appreciate the clarity. We'll decide after internal review and come back with BYOK or EU KMS preference.
evan.re: Great team, I'll capture this in the SOW draft and update the security questionnaire responses.
